subject: Conductor 0.87.6 right-panel terminal close successor
scope: Static read of retained authorized shipped-app extraction; no fresh native observation

source.offset_basis: Zero-based decoded JavaScript character offsets; range includes the full relevant destroy operation

interpretation: Closing the active panel terminal chooses its predecessor; closing the first chooses the new first. Closing an inactive terminal preserves selection, and closing the last clears selection.
regression: Panel order A,B,C, active B, close B: expected A; previous OpenConductor reducer selected C. Tests also cover first/last, inactive closes, and interleaved center terminals.
limits: REA cross-chunk alias resolution is incomplete; bounded reads of the original retained bundles supply the store distinction.
Static source and pure reducer tests do not establish native keyboard focus or installed-app parity.
Center/grouped close and workspace restore are excluded. No browser/native runtime, build, install or workflow dispatch was performed for this correction.
